brief: For North Macedonia's weak-signal layer, the landscape splits into three usable strands. First, hiring: bankarstvo.mk functions as a de-facto sector job-ad aggregator for essentially all MK banks and is the single highest-value entry point, backed by the commercial boards (vrabotuvanje.com.mk, kariera.mk, pazar3.mk, vraboti.se), the state e-Работа register, and individual bank career pages - with LinkedIn the richest but login-walled and non-scrapable channel. Second, events and sponsorship: KIBS (host of EACHA 2026 in Skopje), the МБА, МАСИТ's annual conference, the e-commerce association's regional conference, MicroBalkans 2026 and the Macedonian Stock Exchange conference collectively constitute the MK banking-and-payments event calendar, though sponsor and exhibitor rosters exist only as prose in news coverage rather than structured pages, so capture must be calendar-driven and manual. Third, vendor-side disclosure: international press wires and MK business media (faktor.mk) carry implementation announcements naming the local implementation partner, which is the actor set that bids on subsequent work. The critical structural fact for this cell is that MK commercial banks are outside the public-procurement regime and publish no RFI channel, so these indirect signals are frequently the only public trace an upcoming procurement leaves - and because job ads and event microsites expire quickly, archiving at capture time is not optional.
